pipelines.name: E2E

steps.name: Determine if suite should be skipped
steps.run:
# full-ci mode: run everything
if [[ "$FULL_CI" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  exit 0
fi

# suites that require full-ci are skipped unless full-ci is set (handled above)
if [[ "$REQUIRES_FULL_CI" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "::notice::Skipping suite '$SUITE_NAME' - requires full-ci flag"
  exit 0
fi

# nothing affected -> skip
if [[ -z "$AFFECTED_SUITES" ]]; then
  echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "::notice::Skipping suite '$SUITE_NAME' - no affected packages changed"
  exit 0
fi

# check each test_suite in the comma-separated list
if [[ -n "$TEST_SUITES" ]]; then
  IFS=',' read -ra suites <<< "$TEST_SUITES"
  for suite in "${suites[@]}"; do
    if [[ ",$AFFECTED_SUITES," == *",$suite,"* ]]; then
      echo "skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      exit 0
    fi
  done
fi

# for feature_files entries, extract the suite directory name
if [[ -n "$FEATURE_FILES" ]]; then
  suite_dir=$(echo "$FEATURE_FILES" | sed 's|specs/||' | cut -d'/' -f1)
  if [[ ",$AFFECTED_SUITES," == *",$suite_dir,"* ]]; then
    echo "skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    exit 0
  fi
fi

echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "::notice::Skipping suite '$SUITE_NAME' - no affected packages changed"

steps.run:
echo "=== oCIS LOCAL: relevant log lines ==="
grep -i "ocm\|provider\|invite\|federation\|error\|ERR\|permissions\|drives.*items\|Federated" /tmp/ocis-ocis.log 2>/dev/null | tail -300 || echo "(no log file)"

grep -i "ocm\|provider\|invite\|federation\|error\|ERR\|permissions\|drives.*items\|Federated" /tmp/ocis-ocis-federated.log 2>/dev/null | tail -300 || echo "(no log file)"

pipelines.name: Release NPM

steps.name: Determine package
steps.run:
TAG="${{ github.ref_name }}"
PACKAGES="babel-preset design-system eslint-config extension-sdk prettier-config tsconfig web-client web-pkg web-test-helpers"
for pkg in $PACKAGES; do
  if [[ "$TAG" == "${pkg}-v"* ]]; then
    echo "name=$pkg" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    echo "version=${TAG#${pkg}-v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    break
  fi
done

steps.name: Verify package version
steps.run:
PKG="${{ steps.package.outputs.name }}"
VERSION="${{ steps.package.outputs.version }}"
ACTUAL_VERSION=$(jq -r '.version' < "packages/${PKG}/package.json")
echo "Build ${PKG} ${VERSION} package.json: ${ACTUAL_VERSION}"
if [ "${ACTUAL_VERSION}" != "${VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "git tag does not match version in packages/${PKG}/package.json"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Build package
steps.run:
PKG="${{ steps.package.outputs.name }}"
case "$PKG" in
  design-system|web-client|web-pkg|web-test-helpers)
    pnpm --filter "@ownclouders/${PKG}" vite build
    ;;
esac

pipelines.name: Test and build

steps.name: Resolve full-ci flag
steps.run:
# non-PR events (push, tag) always run the full matrix
if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]]; then
  echo "full-ci=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  exit 0
fi
if [[ "${PR_TITLE,,}" == *"full-ci"* ]]; then
  echo "full-ci=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  echo "full-ci=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi

steps.name: Determine affected test suites
steps.run:
all_suites="admin-settings,spaces,navigation,user-settings,app-store,file-action,shares,search,runtime,app-provider,ocm,oidc,smoke,mfa"
node tests/drone/filterTestSuitesToRun.js "$all_suites" || exit_code=$?
if [ "${exit_code:-0}" -eq 78 ]; then
  echo "suites=" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
elif [ "${exit_code:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit $exit_code
else
  source tests/drone/suites.env
  echo "suites=$TEST_SUITES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi

steps.name: Check all test jobs passed
steps.run:
if [[ "${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}" == "true" ]]; then
  exit 1
fi
